title: Sorrowful
summary: SOR'ROWFUL, adjective 1. Sad; grieving for the loss of some good, or on account of some expected evil. 2. Deeply serious; depressed; dejected. I Sam. 1. 3. Producing sorrow; exciting grief; mournful;

inlines.v: SOR'ROWFUL, adjective 1. Sad; grieving for the loss of some good, or on account of some expected evil. 2. Deeply serious; depressed; dejected. I Sam. 1. 3. Producing sorrow; exciting grief; mournful; as a sorrowful accident. 4. Expressing grief; accompanied with grief; as sorrowful meat. Job 6:7.
